store.name: Sri Lakshmi Mourya Dhaba
store.description:
Sri Lakshmi Mourya Dhaba in Navuluru, Mangalagiri is a family dhaba for biryanis, fried rice, Indo-Chinese starters, Andhra and North Indian curries, tandoori and breads, veg and non-veg.

**On the menu**
- Biryanis: veg, chicken, mutton, fish, prawns and egg, with Mourya Special and SP versions, and family packs to share
- Fried rice: veg, egg, chicken, mixed and Schezwan, plus tomato, zeera and ghee rice
- Starters: 65, Manchurian, chilli, 555, Majestic and pepper dishes in paneer, baby corn, mushroom, egg, chicken, mutton, prawns and fish; tandoori chicken and tikkas
- Curries: Andhra chicken (bone and boneless), butter chicken, mutton, fish and prawns curries, paneer and kaju curries, dal and egg curries
- Naan, roti, kulcha, paratha and pulka; curd rice, lassi and kaddu ka kheer

**Good to know**
- Open every day, 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM
- 216 dishes, from ₹10 to ₹1800
- Veg and non-veg; veg dishes are marked

items.name: Kaju Biryani
items.description:

Ingredients (Typical):
- Basmati rice
